high_level_description: The image shows a display of colorful ceramic tiles arranged on a shelf. The tiles are square-shaped and feature a vibrant floral design with large, stylized flowers in the center. Each flower has a bright orange petal layer, a pink inner layer, and a blue circular center. The petals are outlined with white, and there are green leaves and small orange accents around the flowers. The background of the tiles is either light blue or dark blue, depending on which set of tiles is being shown. The tiles are neatly stacked in rows, suggesting they are for sale or display in a shop or market.
